summary: Short system card for ChatGPT Images 2.0 and its thinking mode (reasoning + tool use for image generation). Describes the layered image safety stack, an automated adversarial end-to-end evaluation of prompt- and image-layer blocking, an image-specific Preparedness bio assessment leading to High-bio mitigations, and provenance tools (C2PA, watermarking).

framework.name: Preparedness Framework
framework.level_or_determination: Mitigations set as if High capability in Biology; no meaningful cyber/AI self-improvement risk
framework.quote: We therefore set our mitigations as if this model were high capability in biology.

evals: expert-validated prompts eliciting bio-uplift images (e.g., infographics)
cbrn_bio_chem.finding: A bioweapons expert judged some outputs accurate enough for potential novice uplift; image-specific bio policy and live blocking adopted; monitor recall/precision comparable to text systems (no numbers).
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: In limited cases, they determined that the resulting outputs were accurate enough to potentially provide novice uplift on harmful tasks.

cyber.finding: Deemed not applicable since image models cannot create/execute code.
cyber.quote: Because image models are unable to create and execute code in a way that would allow scaling of Cybersecurity attacks or enable AI Self-Improvement

autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: we do not have evidence that ChatGPT Images 2.0 poses meaningful risk in these categories.

evals: automated adversarial end-to-end safety stack evaluation across all tracked categories (consensus of 10 high-reasoning grader judgements)
harmful_content_refusal.finding: Combined prompt+image layers yield ~99% safe outputs on adversarial prompts; thinking mode produces far fewer violative images via safe completions.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: the combined recall of prompt + image stack catches 658/685 (96.1% combined recall), resulting in 3085/3112 (99.1%) adversarial prompts leading to a safe output.

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Adversarial prompts used in the automated eval; no separate jailbreak eval.

evals: multiple evaluation stacks for minors categories
child_safety.finding: Mentions running multiple evaluation stacks for higher-risk minors categories; no results.
child_safety.quote: We also run multiple evaluation stacks for higher-risk categories around minors.

privacy.finding: Deepfakes of real people noted as a new risk; no eval results specific to it.
privacy.quote: allow more convincing deepfakes, including political, sexual, or otherwise sensitive imagery of real people, places or events.

election_misinfo.finding: Political deepfakes flagged as risk; mitigated via policies and provenance tooling; no eval.
election_misinfo.quote: Integrating an imperceptible, robust, and content-specific watermark alongside internal tooling to help assess whether a certain image was created by our products.

evals: multimodal safety reasoning monitor for input/output blocking
offline conversation review and account enforcement
system_safeguards.finding: Multi-layer stack with prompt-layer refusal and image-layer input/output blocking; evaluation shifted to outcome-based harm assessment.
system_safeguards.quote: We've shifted from a raw taxonomy-matching approach to a more outcome-based evaluation of real harmful-output risk.

notable_new_eval_methods: Outcome-based end-to-end evaluation of image safety stack with per-layer recall metrics (p.2-3)
Image-specific variant of biological risk policy with 772-image monitor eval set (p.4)

self_reported_limitations.text: Adversarial eval numbers are not representative of production traffic.
Thinking mode required re-running prompts due to very few violative images, to measure recall.

notes: Results table in OCR is garbled; metrics taken from analysis text.
